title: Sharp Data-Processing Region for Quantum Conditional Rényi Entropies
summary: We study the three-parameter family of quantum conditional Rényi entropies $H_{α,z}^λ$ introduced in \textit{Commun. Math. Phys.} 407, 180 (2026). We prove that the previously established data-processing region is sharp. We then characterize the club-sandwiched family through a classical coarse-graining principle: within the full data-processing region, universal monotonicity under deterministic coarse-graining of the classical conditioned register holds if and only if $z = α$.
